formulas.faction_gate: eligible only when every required gate >= its saved minimum; no average may substitute for a failed essential gate

input_rules.evidence_components: quality and reliability are 0..100; reliability is applied as a percentage; custody_factor and corroboration_factor are 0..1; contradiction_penalty is nonnegative numeric evidence pressure
input_rules.legal_components: legal finding components are saved numeric values tied to actual evidence, authority, procedure, and defenses; unstored narrative impressions contribute 0
input_rules.power_basis_points: each office/troop/money/land/household/network/popular/legal/procedure basis is a saved 0..200 contribution and may be counted once only for the deciding body
input_rules.procedure_factor: saved 0..1 ability to use the current procedure; absence of a procedural route is 0
input_rules.reach_factor: saved 0..1 physical/legal reach into deciding body or enforcement area
input_rules.readiness_components: war-capacity components use the same saved 0..200 readiness scale
input_rules.scheme_components: all scheme progress/exposure components are saved numeric 0..100 values created before resolution; missing values block the step

rule: Progress, exposure, evidence, legal judgment, enforcement, coalition support, and public belief are separate state. No score creates access, authority, evidence, resources, or physical effects that do not exist.
